avis.texte: I've tried a lot of blemish treatments, but this one is honestly so unique. I have super sensitive skin and was a bit nervous to try a new product, especially on problem areas. But my breakout looked noticeably less red overnight, and as a heavy makeup wearer, I love that I can wear it during the day without it peeling under a full face.

BEST BUY FOR EMERGENCIES! I've tried quite a few pimple patches, and these Yellow Cream Patches really surprised me. They're super thin and blend perfectly with the skin and almost look invisible.. even during the day. They stick well and stay in place overnight without peeling off. The redness looks reduced when I wake up in the morning, making the spot look much less irritated.

I really like this spot treatment. It's cool how it starts like a cream and then dries into a patch over the blemish. I noticed my pimple looked way calmer the next day. Super easy to use and works well under makeup too.

I used too much the first time, so it took a long time to dry and felt sticky.😅 But when I tried applying a thin layer, I realized that controlling the amount is key. With a thin layer, it dries quickly and doesn't feel sticky at all. It forms a protective film over the pimple, which makes it much easier to apply makeup on top. It helps cover the acne, improves overall blemish coverage, and makes my makeup go on more smoothly. Most importantly, my pimple calmed down faster than usual. I'm very satisfied and would definitely buy it again!
The cream worked really well for hiding my pimples under makeup & it wasn't too icky on my face!
I can see it is kind of like a liquid bandage. When it dries down it still stays shiny. More seamless than putting on a patch but still too detectable even under makeup. Its a pass for me.
It reduce the appearance of my pimple in a couple of days! I was using twice a day once in the morning and at night and it god rid of it in a about 3 days
